name: agent-corpus-tools
description: Monorepo of coding-agent-agnostic developer tools, published under the @agent-corpus npm scope.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-corpus/agent-scaffold && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/audit-log && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/policy-manager && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/pr-watch && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/tracker-core && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/issue-watch && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/task-report && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/project-watch && npm run build -w @agent-corpus/live-board
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
